description.subtitle: 3rd adidas equipment children's t-shirt from Liverpool 2025 2026 - turquoise
description.tagline: The third skin Red for smaller fans
description.intro: With Liverpool Junior's adidas 25/26 T-shirt, children can wear the third gear that connects legacy and modernity. A Network identity symbol for the new generation.
key_benefits: Comfort: Lightweight and soft fabric adapted to the day to day of the youngest.
Breathability: AEROREADY technology that maintains freshness even during the game.
Pride Red: Official Liverpool Shield in children's version.
Sostenibilidad: Elaborada con materiales reciclados que apoyan el cuidado del planeta.
